_description: Cash balance is unaffected by a black-swan event — verifies the growth-loop bypass also skips the black-swan overlay.
_rationale: $100k cash with 0% yield. A black-swan event in year 0 (stockMultiplier 0.5, bondMultiplier 0.5 — simulating a -50% catastrophe). Cash must NOT be shocked: at end of year 0 (before spending), cash balance must still be $100k (0% yield, no shock). With spending of $20k, cash ends year 0 at exactly $80k. No stock/bond accounts so the black swan is purely informational; the test is that cash bypass takes precedence.
name: Cash Skips Black Swan
